page.title: Tax declarations
page.subtitle: What your accountant declared each quarter, kept apart from the books and compared with them — for your own tracking.
page.ownerOnly: Only the owner can see the tax declarations.
page.disclaimer: Your own record of the declarations your accountant filed, typed from the filed PDFs. It is kept apart from your entries, invoices and their files, and is only compared with the books, quarter by quarter, to show gaps. It is not a declaration and not a statement of compliance — the flags are questions, not conclusions. Only you can see this page.

stats.knownDetail: Set apart, each with your note
stats.quarters: {count, plural, one {# quarter} other {# quarters}} in the table

flags.title: To look at
flags.subtitle: Gaps between the declarations and the books. When you've looked at one, mark it as known with your note — it stays here, set apart.
flags.reopenConfirm: Reopen this flag? Your note comes off it; the history keeps it.
flags.notePlaceholder: Why it stands — e.g. your decision and when to look again
flags.changed: The figure has moved since your note (it was {was}) — worth another look.
flags.provisionalPart: {amount} of the books' figure is at a provisional exchange rate, so the difference may still move.

notDeclared.title: {period}: the books show {amount} more sales than the VAT declaration
notDeclared.body: Sales booked in {period} are above total sales declared in [34] — see Books vs declarations below. Part may be timing or exchange rates; whether the rest belongs on a declaration is a question for you and your accountant. (WF-TTT-03, WF-REC-04)

declaredMore.title: {period}: the VAT declaration shows {amount} more sales than the books
declaredMore.body: Usually exchange rates (the declaration uses the rate on each invoice date) or an invoice issued in a different quarter from the money. Worth a look if it keeps growing.

missingReturn.title: {period}: no {form} recorded here
missingReturn.body: If one was filed, record it with its PDF so the quarter is complete. If none was needed, mark it as known with a note.

creditChain.title: {period}: [22] doesn't match the credit carried from last quarter
creditChain.body: [22] here is {actual}, but the previous quarter carried {expected} forward in [43]. A typing slip, a supplementary declaration not recorded here, or a difference adjusted through [37]/[38]?

math.title: {form} {period}: line [{code}] doesn't add up
math.body: The form's own arithmetic gives {expected}; the record says {actual}. Check the figure against the filed PDF.

bhxhNoStaff.title: {period}: social insurance paid, but no employees on the PIT declaration
bhxhNoStaff.body: Social insurance (BHXH) contributions paid from the bank this quarter: {amount}. The 05/KK-TNCN declaration shows 0 employees — who is insured, and is a salary paid? (WF-TTT-05)

bhxhMonthMissing.title: {month}: no BHXH contribution found
bhxhMonthMissing.body: Social insurance is paid every month, but no BHXH contribution for {month} is in the imported bank statements. If it was paid, import that month's statement; if not, ask your accountant — a late contribution can draw interest. (WF-TTT-05)

filedLate.title: {form} {period}: filed after the due date
filedLate.body: Filed {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after the due date recorded here ({date}). Is a late-filing penalty expected? Your accountant will know.

notFiled.title: {form} {period}: due {date}, not marked as filed
notFiled.body: The due date recorded here passed {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago and no filing date is recorded. If it was filed, add the date and the PDF; if not, ask your accountant.

returns.title: Declarations by quarter
returns.subtitle: Key lines of the latest filing for each quarter. Open a declaration to see every line and its files.
returns.supplements: {count, plural, one {# earlier filing} other {# earlier filings}}

compare.title: Books vs declarations
compare.subtitle: Sales booked in each quarter (income reviewed or posted, in VND) against total sales declared in [34]. Bank interest is financial income, not a sale: it is left out of the books figure and shown apart. Totals only — no entry is linked to a declaration.
compare.none: Record a VAT declaration to compare it with the books.
compare.note: Differences are shown, never offset. The books are cash-basis at each entry's rate; the declaration follows invoice dates and the invoice-date exchange rate.

form.figures: Figures as printed on the declaration
form.figuresHint: Whole đồng (or people), no decimals. Leave blank for 0. Only [36] can be negative — type it in brackets or with a minus.
form.valueColumn: Value of goods and services (before VAT)
form.files: Files: the filed PDF, the XML, your accountant's lists
form.filesHint: PDF, XML, Excel, ZIP or images. Kept with the declaration only; only you can open them.
form.deleteConfirm: Delete the {form} declaration for {period}? Its files are deleted too; the history keeps a note.
form.removeFileConfirm: Delete {name}? The file is deleted for good; the history keeps a note.

gtgt.37: Adjustment down of VAT credit from earlier periods
gtgt.38: Adjustment up of VAT credit from earlier periods
gtgt.41: VAT credit not used this period

tncn.17: of which residents with a labour contract
tncn.24: of which life / voluntary insurance premiums paid to insurers not established in Vietnam
tncn.25: Exempt under oil and gas contracts
tncn.32: of which PIT withheld on those insurance premiums

errors.figure: Line [{code}]: whole numbers only (only [36] can be negative).
errors.duplicate: A {form} declaration for {period} with that supplement number is already recorded.
errors.gone: That record no longer exists — reload the page.
errors.fileType: {name}: only PDF, XML, Excel, ZIP or image files.
